about: A second set for `hxq owner`, written after the ranking was tuned on owner-paraphrases.json by the same author, who had read the owners' docs, so it is not held out (several questions echo an owned question's wording): owner questions in other words, and controls whose answer is an operation or a config reader that states no owned question, so a bonus for owned questions cannot win by crowding them out. Read by unit.query.OwnerParaphraseTest.

is the result of the if expression discarded
keep a haxe --wait server alive across lint runs
infer the type of a local variable without an annotation
which static does an unqualified function call refer to
does this assignment modify the field that expression reads
members declared under conditional compilation
names introduced by a wildcard import
which declaration does a qualified type path like pkg.Mod.Sub denote
is the receiver of a static call a type or a value
prove that the start argument of substr is non-negative
add an import statement to a file
extract selected statements into a new function
inline a method body at every call site
